newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks show weaker bias in London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks show weaker bias in London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded here were stable with a weaker overall bias in a quiet market, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 was 2.97 points down at 1,450.29 by 1332 GMT on Thursday.
"We've seen a little buying of banks but it looks like just a bit of short covering but it hasn't moved the shares and it's done nothing particularly to the index," said one dealer.
A rebound in the financial sector helped the Nikkei 225 advance in Tokyo last night.
